properties.title: Pumptrack Sarneraatal
properties.abstract: The pump track is located at Giswil school. The main track is very varied with plenty of connections, a long straight section and big curves. The smaller Zinsli track is suitable for children and beginners and is well separated from the main one. All motorless roller sports equipment is permitted, such as bicycles, wheels, kickboards, in-lines and skateboards.

Length main track: 230m 
Length  Zinsli-Track: 60m
Area: 2000m2
properties.name: Flow Bikeverein

de.abstract: Der Pumptrack befindet sich bei der Schule Giswil. Der Haupt-Track bietet mit vielen Connections, einer langen Gerade und grossen Kurven viel Abwechslung. Der kleinere Zinsli-Track eignet sich für Kinder und Anfänger. Er ist gut vom Haupt-Track getrennt. Erlaubt sind alle Rollsportgeräte ohne Motor, etwa Velos, Laufräder, Kickboards, Inlines oder Skateboards.

fr.abstract: Le pump track se trouve près de l’école de Giswil. La piste principale, avec ses nombreuses connexions, sa longue ligne droite et ses grands virages, est très variée. La piste Zinsli, plus petite, convient aux enfants et aux débutants. Elle est bien séparée de la piste principale. Tous les engins de sport à roues non motorisés, tels que vélos, draisiennes, kickboards, rollers ou skateboards, sont autorisés.

it.abstract: Il pump track si trova presso la scuola di Giswil. La pista principale offre una grande varietà con molti collegamenti, un lungo rettilineo e grandi curve. Il breve «Zinsli-Track» è adatto a bambini e principianti ed è chiaramente separato dalla pista principale. Sono ammesse tutte le attrezzature sportive senza motore provviste di ruote: biciclette, bici da corsa, kickboard, pattini in linea e skateboard.
